headline: Severe Clashes Reopen Across Weathered Expanse as Island Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since the previous edition, strategic base exchanges have surged across Weathered Expanse, where nine transitions were logged over the past two hours around Wightwalk and Spirit Watch amidst heavy casualty exchanges exceeding three thousand men. In Linn of Mercy, renewed maneuvering generated five base shifts centered on The First Coin while two-hour casualties surpassed two thousand. Island engagements continue unabated in Godcrofts, logging seven further base events around Argosa, Lipsia, and Saegio to expand Colonial control to six strongpoints against three Warden positions. Active contestation also pressed forward on the Stlican Shelf and in Dead Lands, each recording five base events over the two-hour span around The Pale House and Callahan's Boot respectively. While direct territorial turnover paused in Stonecradle and Farranac Coast, both sectors endured punishing attrition, absorbing over twenty-eight hundred and two thousand casualties in the latest two-hour window. Minor shifts also touched Oarbreaker at Grisly Refuge as combat along the central and coastal sectors remains unrelenting.
